# Scroll Swap

> Scroll Swap is Scroll's official concentrated-liquidity AMM — connect a wallet, pick a pair, and swap tokens directly on Scroll Mainnet.

## Key facts
- Type: AMM / DEX
- Networks: Scroll Mainnet (EVM chain ID 534352)
- Custody: Non-custodial — your wallet signs
- Costs: Pool fee + network gas + price impact
- Token in/out: the pair you choose
- Verify: Check the pool and contract in the live app
